study_identification_part.si4_title: Deep Normative Tractometry for Identifying Joint White Matter Macro- and Micro-structural Abnormalities in Alzheimer's Disease

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: This study introduces the Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT) framework to encode the joint distribution of white matter macrostructural and microstructural profiles, and applies it to identify along-tract abnormalities in mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and Alzheimer's disease (AD) patients.

rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.answer: NIMHANS data: DWI denoising (local PCA); Gibbs ringing removal; susceptibility distortion correction; eddy current correction; bias field inhomogeneity correction; diffusion tensor fitting (non-linear least-squares); RUMBA-SD (fiber orientation reconstruction); particle filtering tracking (whole-brain tractograms, 8 seeds/voxel, step 0.2mm, angular threshold 30 deg); DIPY RecoBundles (WM bundle segmentation in native and MNI space); MNI (Montreal Neurological Institute) space (atlas). TractoInferno data: Constrained spherical deconvolution; deterministic tracking (whole-brain tractograms); DIPY RecoBundles (WM bundle segmentation in native and MNI space); MNI (Montreal Neurological Institute) space (atlas).
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.reason: The paper provides a comprehensive list of preprocessing steps for both the NIMHANS and TractoInferno datasets, including specific techniques, software/libraries, and parameters where available.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.supporting_text: Preprocessing steps for all DWI volumes included: denoising using local principal component analysis [23], Gibbs ringing removal [24], [25], correction of susceptibility-induced distortion [26], eddy currents [27] and bias field inhomogeneity [28]. Diffusion tensors were fitted with non-linear least-squares to produce fractional anisotropy (FA) and medial diffusivity (MD) scalar maps in the DWI native space. Fiber orientations were reconstructed using Robust and Unbiased Model-BAsed Spherical Deconvolution (RUMBA-SD) [29], [30]. Particle filtering tracking [31] was using to generate whole-brain tractograms (WBT), with 8 seeds per voxel generated from the WM mask, step size of 0 . 2 mm, angular threshold of 30 ◦ , and the continuous map stopping criterion." and "Constrained spherical deconvolution [33] and deterministic tracking [34] were used to generate WBTs. For both the datasets, DIPY's [34] auto-calibrated RecoBundles [7], [35] was used to segment thirty WM bundles in the native and MNI (Montreal Neurological Institute) space [36].
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.location: Feng2024.pdf.md: Section II. DATA, Paragraph 2 and 3
